responsibility: Implements Darwin host hooks for precompiled-header address management. It reserves a large statically aligned virtual address region for PCH loading, returns that region when the requested PCH fits, and validates and remaps the PCH file into that exact address while unmapping unused tail pages. This file is host-side runtime support for stable PCH mmap placement on Darwin, not target code generation.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation half of the host-darwin pair: it contains the Darwin host-side PCH address reservation, munmap, and mmap logic for fixed-address precompiled-header loading, while gcc/config/host-darwin.h only declares those helpers and installs them in the HOST_HOOKS_GT_PCH_* macros.
